Kosmonauts.basis: This week: Sleeper (Yahoo's own isn't readable yet) projections in your league's scoring. Rest of season: Sleeper's projections for the next 4 weeks in your scoring, per game played (byes skipped; QB/RB/WR/TE; a week Sleeper hasn't re-projected since a trade or new starting job uses his current weekly projection; IR players count 0 for the 4-game IR minimum). Value: FantasyCalc redraft for your league's settings. Ranks are by position among every rostered player and the best free agents. Experts: ESPN's fantasy analysts' consensus position rank this week (their PPR ranks averaged; QB/RB/WR/TE) and lately (median of their last 3 weekly ranks, weeks he was out or on a bye skipped); green/red = they rank him 10+ spots (QB/TE 6+) better/worse than our this-week rank. Other teams' rosters aren't readable here yet (Yahoo API pending), so ranks are among your roster and the free agents only.
